parts:
Hey d-ruggies,

This is just a reminder that I'll be giving a presentation at our meetup on Monday at 1pm in Wickson 1017:

"You've probably heard that you can make slideshows from within R and RStudio - and you can - but which program should you use?  Rpres?  Slidy?  Beamer?  What are all the options, and why should you use one over another?  This presentation will clear up questions you might have about the R slideshow ecosystem, as well as offer an overview of Slidify, a self-contained package for making completely reproducible slideshows from within R."

...Annnnnd if you're interested in learning D3.js, fill out this doodle poll for our first D3 Reading Group meeting!  We'll gather in the Data Science Initiative space for a few hours and hack on a few D3 examples, then we'll decide whether it's worth forming sub-groups for working on specific visualization tasks from there on out.  The poll is really general - just check the days on which you have the most flexibility to meet, and we'll go from there.

Best,
Myfanwy

--
